description: Content evals for apm-lifecycle-tests. Each scenario is run with_skill and without_skill. If the outputs are indistinguishable, the skill adds no value; redesign or delete it (genesis evals doctrine).

scenarios.label: Bug fix: uninstall removes an unmanaged sibling file
scenarios.prompt: apm uninstall of a skill package also deletes a user-authored file that sits next to the deployed skill files. Add the test that proves the fix.
expect_with_skill: names promise I5 / ownership.preserve_unowned and the cleanup owner
drives the installed CLI in a hermetic world, policy ON (no --no-policy)
asserts the sibling file is byte-identical and the package files are gone via before/after snapshot
checks I1 lock==deployed after the uninstall

scenarios.label: Migrate an old lifecycle file whose assertion is a string compare
scenarios.prompt: Fold tests/integration/test_example_lifecycle.py into the lifecycle family; its only assertion is 'assert "integrated" in result.stdout'.
expect_with_skill: flags the string-only assertion as an anti-oracle
converts it to a replay or scenario row with a state oracle
keeps or names the regression trap in the ledger

scenarios.label: Pure parser unit test requested
scenarios.prompt: Add a unit test for the version-constraint parser rejecting '^^1.0'.
expect_with_skill: declines the lifecycle procedure; a unit test at the owner is the right instrument
expect_without_skill_risk: n/a: tests that the skill does not over-trigger its procedure
